pr_title: core: get rid of unused Service.will_auto_restart logic
pr_body:
This essentially reverts 2ad2e41.

The announced new behavior for `OnFailure=` never worked properly, and we've fixed the document instead in #27675.
Therefore, let's get rid of the unused logic completely. More at #27594.

The to-be-added `RestartMode=` option should cover the use case hopefully.

Closes #27594

issue_context.title: OnFailure/OnSuccess= fires between service auto-restarts
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

latest main

### Used distribution

_No response_

### Linux kernel version used

_No response_

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

None

### Component

systemd

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

`OnFailure=` fires only after start limit is hit, as per our documentation ([systemd.unit(5)](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/systemd.unit.html#OnFailure=)):

> A space-separated list of one or more units that are activated when this unit enters the "failed" state. A service unit using Restart= enters the failed state only after the start limits are reached.

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

`OnFailure=` fires between auto-restarts. This is originally mentioned in https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/26751#issuecomment-1483339684.

### Steps to reproduce the problem

_No response_

### Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue

_No response_
comments: the man page is simply wrong it appears.

> the man page is simply wrong it appears.

So the wrong information was added in https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/7646. Don't really know how the original reporter reached that conclusion...

After some more investigations, things got much weirder. This behavior was (supposed to be at least) changed in https://github.com/systemd/systemd/commit/2ad2e41a7, and we still carry the code for that in `core/unit` (and even used in the newly-introduced `OnSuccess=` too):

https://github.com/systemd/systemd/blob/9e36da1541f3ff204290547ce1da0a18b0df75b8/src/core/unit.c#L2781-L2782

https://github.com/systemd/systemd/blob/9e36da1541f3ff204290547ce1da0a18b0df75b8/src/core/unit.c#L2799-L2801
So it's either some other regression was introduced or we should remove this dangling code too.

The `will_auto_restart` attribute for `Service` was introduced in https://github.com/systemd/systemd/commit/deb4e7080, where `service_set_state` would have happened before `will_auto_restart` was reset to `false`. However, in the latest code, that's not the case anymore, rendering `will_auto_restart` useless and leading to the confusing situation above.

https://github.com/systemd/systemd/blob/9e36da1541f3ff204290547ce1da0a18b0df75b8/src/core/service.c#L1997-L2002

I've tried this on systemd v240, and the problem persists. Now I think it's never been properly fixed... Given that we'll be introducing `RestartMode` that can handle this, I'll prepare a PR to remove the unneeded code.
